commits.message:
feat(hermes-400): add persisted, deduplicated taxonomy suggestion queue with fuzzy hints

The taxonomy has not grown since HERMES-400 closed 2026-07-14 (still 35
skills / 42 aliases / 14 titles / 37 title aliases) despite weeks of live
resume/email parsing. Root cause: POST /understanding/taxonomy/suggestions
computed a fresh, stateless list on every call - nothing was ever stored,
so there was no durable backlog to review even if someone wanted to, and
the same unknown term would be re-suggested on every single occurrence
with no memory of prior sightings or decisions.

This does not touch matching or normalize_skill()/normalize_job_title() -
those stay exact-match deterministic, per HERMES-400 own safety rule
("matching remains deterministic"). And it does not weaken "unknown terms
are not auto-approved" - every suggestion still requires an explicit
human approve/reject call. What changes is that review is now tractable:

- app/understanding/taxonomy/suggestion_store.py: persists each unique
  observed term once (deduped by normalized key) on the existing
  /hermes-runtime volume, incrementing an occurrence_count and collecting
  source_contexts across repeated sightings instead of re-surfacing the
  same term endlessly. New GET .../suggestions/queue (sorted by
  occurrence_count, i.e. highest-impact terms first),
  POST .../suggestions/{id}/approve, POST .../suggestions/{id}/reject.
- app/understanding/taxonomy/fuzzy.py: attaches a did-you-mean hint
  (candidate + rapidfuzz score) to a suggestion when it is a likely
  formatting variant of an existing canonical/alias term (e.g. "React Js"
  vs "React"/"ReactJS"). This never skips or auto-resolves review - it
  only makes the human decision faster (approve the hinted value in one
  click instead of researching it).
- app/understanding/taxonomy/overlay.py: approved suggestions land in a
  runtime-volume overlay file, merged into the skill/title alias indexes
  live (build_skill_alias_index()/build_title_alias_index() no longer
  lru_cached) - no restart or redeploy needed for an approval to take
  effect. The git-tracked seed JSON files are left as the deliberate,
  reviewed baseline; folding the overlay into them is a separate,
  intentional action for later.
- app/understanding/taxonomy/suggestions.py: build_taxonomy_suggestions()
  now also upserts into the queue and attaches fuzzy_match as an
  additional field - its existing pinned contract
  (scripts/hermes-400-suggestion-queue-check.py: accepted_count == 0,
  every suggestion status == review_required/confidence == low) is
  unchanged and still passes.

Verified: 5/5 new checks pass (fuzzy hint attaches without skipping
review, 3x duplicate submission collapses to 1 queue entry with
occurrence_count=3, approve() makes a term normalize live with no
restart, reject() leaves the normalizer unaffected, the pinned legacy
suggestion-queue check still passes unmodified). Full regression: all 7
existing HERMES-400 checks and all 3 HERMES-850 checks still pass. App
imports cleanly, 106 OpenAPI paths (103 before + 3 new).
